scripts.aws:login: sh -c 'aws sts get-caller-identity --profile Game >/dev/null 2>&1 || aws sso login --profile Game'
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm aws:login && pnpm build && pnpm --filter infra exec cdk deploy --profile Game -c stage=dev
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm aws:login && pnpm build && pnpm --filter infra exec cdk deploy --profile Game -c stage=prod
scripts.destroy:dev: pnpm aws:login && pnpm --filter infra exec cdk destroy --profile Game -c stage=dev
scripts.diff: pnpm aws:login && pnpm build && pnpm --filter infra exec cdk diff --profile Game
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
